# complacent

> Self-satisfied, smug; overly content (and therefore lazy, neglectful, or some other bad quality)

> smugly self-satisfied, often without awareness of potential dangers


## Example

- *After the water polo team won their sixth championship, they became complacent and didn't even make it to the playoffs the next year.*
